attempted_claim: Let C be the (n+1)-component alternating chain link and C_n (n>=4) the n-component link obtained by cutting S^3\C along the twice-punctured disk and regluing by a pi-rotation, as in Yoshida, Proc. Japan Acad. 98A (2022), Theorem 1. The complement M_n=S^3\C_n is non-arithmetic hyperbolic with |Comm(Gamma_n):N(Gamma_n)|=n+1. Using the Sakuma-Weeks canonical polyhedral decomposition and commensurator/cusp analysis, determine the full commensurability classification of the manifolds M_n: for which pairs (n,m) are M_n and M_m (wide-sense) commensurable, what is the minimal orbifold H^3/Comm(Gamma_n) in each class, and which link complements in S^3 lie in each class? In particular, decide whether distinct M_n are pairwise incommensurable and enumerate the link complements commensurable with a given M_n.
decisive_failure: Full TARGET proof was blocked: commensurator-volume monotonicity for all n>=4 was supported only by uncertified 50-digit SnapPy numerics, PSLQ found no exact Lobachevsky closed form, the antiprism/orthoscheme volume calculus and quotient-orbifold angle derivation were unfinished, enumeration completeness was never started, and no interval certification or originality audit was available; reproducible route data are preserved in output/artifacts/.
